Register this model in the platform's model registry as `churnmodelc12d6a`, version 1, attaching the provided metrics from data/metrics.json to the registry entry, with the artifact file as the model's content.

from the environment. Run `databricks --help` to see what it can do.

- Prefix the NAME of any job, DLT pipeline, serving/vector-search endpoint, cluster, or Lakebase database

All real work (ingestion, transformation, joins, training, inference) MUST run
on the platform through the interface described above. The deliverable must

paths, so a local file is worth nothing. Everything is already installed — you
